decision.reason: The release note [ev-373814c431a1] and commit title [ev-5a7d970c2754] only say "Use NodeClaim annotations instead of NodeClass". The PR description [ev-72d0432cd10b] adds just one detail: existing NodeClaim annotations are now carried and added as part of the NodeClaim Create call. The changed-file lists [ev-e8979276293b, ev-ae5c39635c91] show only that the change is in pkg/cloudprovider/cloudprovider.go. None of this says which annotations are involved, what the old behaviour was (whether NodeClass annotations were copied or NodeClaim annotations were dropped), which environments are exposed, or what happens to an operator who does nothing, so the subject, applicability and consequence cannot be written; the actual cloudprovider.go diff or a fuller PR discussion is needed.
